mapper.select: SELECT id, invitation_code AS invitationCode, name, phone, company, position, reason, status, review_remark AS reviewRemark, created_at AS createdAt, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM t_application WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, invitation_code AS invitationCode, name, phone, company, position, reason, status, review_remark AS reviewRemark, created_at AS createdAt, reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM t_application WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_application (invitation_code, name, phone, company, position, reason, status) VALUES (#{invitationCode}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{company}, #{position}, #{reason}, 'PENDING')
